sources.title: Chinese Moonshot AI Kimi K3 Is the Biggest Open-Source AI Model Ever ...
sources.snippet: On 17 July 2026, Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3 at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai: the world's largest open-source AI model at 2.8 trillion parameters, backed by Chinese tech giants Alibaba and Tencent, and valued at over $20 billion following a $2 billion raise in May.
